title: How to Add Confidence Boosters to Checkout Sign Up Pages
text:
## How to Add Confidence Boosters to Checkout Sign Up Pages
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000048091
Confidence boosters help users feel more confident about their purchase in the last few seconds when they might just regret adding their card.
Ensuring the potential client that the website uses secure payment methods to collect from their card and reminding them about features they will get as soon as they join will help prevent the bounce rate at the checkout page and make sure more people complete the cycle of becoming a customer.
In this article, we provide the code and instructions in order to implement a confidence booster in the checkout pages to increase conversions.
